dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: This should all be written up and reported back to the Institute...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have to report?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Changes in the local hydrological environment, the way those meka operate in the wild, and... some residual Arkhium energy flow.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I think these energy flows are just remnants from the explosion. Some shattered Arkhium crystals were washed down here, but it's not like there's anything serious going on.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: But just to be on the safe side, I'll compile a report and send it back to the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: ...But I don't want to set foot in the Fontaine Research Institute ever again, if I can help it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Bye. The road conditions around here are a little difficult, so be careful walking.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your thoughts on the Fontaine Research Institute...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I have no opinion or views on the Fontaine Research Institute now.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: ...Once, I poured my heart into my work. My passion, my sweat... I devoted so much.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I'm tired now though, and happy with ordinary data collection work.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I have absolutely no aptitude for research.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who says you don't?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Edwin, he... Edwin Eastinghouse said it himself.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: He was my superior, and the one who decided if I had any aptitude or not!

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: ...If that's all, I really should be getting back to work. There's still so much data to collect.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Nothing good happened today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I... I don't want to go back to the Fontaine Research Institute. But you gotta have somewhere to stay, right?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I can't go beg for a place to stay in Lumidouce Harbor, and I don't want to stay at The Rusty Rudder. So... the Institute helped me get in touch with Chaussivert, who is letting me stay on his ship for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: It's only temporary. I'll be outta here as soon as I find somewhere proper to live.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Bye. It's getting late, I should probably be calling it a day too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you used to being here yet?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: ...It's great. Staying on the ship means that at least no one's gonna suddenly turn up and cause me trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: However, apart from the Institute I don't think anyone else would contact me.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I just hope that every night from now on will be quiet and undisturbed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Chaussivert and Lemarcq...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: When I'm staying on the ship, they go to another cabin and don't bother me.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: I always bring some snacks and drinks as gifts when I come... I don't like drinking alcohol, and don't like seeing other people drunk.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: But, speaking of alcohol... I haven't seen a single bottle on board this ship. I asked Lemarcq, who just said that everything's already been drunk.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: But with Chaussivert around, will the wine racks on this ship really stay empty? It's strange...
